releases.notes: Replaced the buggy Player Nametags module with four new useful modules: Sound Indicator (expanding rings at nearby sounds, color-coded for steps/explosions), Coordinates (XYZ, facing, biome), Speedometer (m/s and km/h) and Potion Effects (icons with remaining time). Website updated to 15 modules with a sound-ring mockup.

releases.notes:
## Meridian 1.3.0 - Minecraft 1.21.8

### New
- Backup & Transfer screen: export your settings, waypoints and macros to a file, import them on another computer, or reset everything to defaults (Meridian menu > Backup & Transfer).
- Config menu default key is now **Page Up** (rebindable in Controls).

### Changes
- Visit Website menu entry opens the official site (https://meridian-mod.vercel.app/).

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.8, Fabric API 0.136.1+, Fabric Loader 0.16.13+, Java 21+.

Drop `meridian.jar` into your `mods` folder together with Fabric API.

readmeSummary: A modern client-side HUD suite for Minecraft 1.21.8 (Fabric). Meridian brings an extensive, fully configurable heads-up display to your game: keystrokes, click tracking, ping, memory, server details,...
